details: Dropper. At run time the package downloads a Windows batch file from a remote URL into the system temporary directory and executes it with child_process.exec. The payload is fetched, not shipped, so the code that runs is controlled by the remote host. Version examined: 1.0.0; tarball SHA-256 ea725cf1c5c950a7a8f091a717cfd2a76e7dd7b81000afe37b7398c76f3c4e3a.
